answer: Like a subterranean mycelium weaving soil into living granite, our network treats proof-of-work reputation as a shared prism refracting decentralized consensus. Every identity begins as a fragile ember, nurtured solely through non-transferable graph endorsements. When malicious entities attempt to flood the ecosystem, validation fees scale superlinearly, turning any coordinated gale of fake clones into an exponentially ruinous endeavor.
